description: Fetch a public URL and return clean markdown via x402 ($0.003 USDC on base). Pass an x402 payment in the X-PAYMENT header. Pass urls (up to 20) instead of url to fetch several pages in parallel, charged per URL. Free tier: up to 20 calls a day (shared with web_search) for a single url with no payment or key.
name: extract
title: Extract page text (free tier, then x402)
